purpose: Implement the requested data-retention policy: after every dependent reproduction and archive is accepted, remove only an exact project-owned reproducible model root while retaining all data, predictions, metrics, logs, manifests, source, environments, and archives.
per_model_eligibility_record_required: status DRY_RUN_ELIGIBLE and exact model id, repository, immutable revision, literal target, and literal unique sibling quarantine
exact frozen retention-policy and ownership-ledger paths and SHA-256 values
terminal-accepted materialization record and complete MODEL_SHA256SUMS identity
live device, inode, regular-file count, byte count, and path-size-content tree SHA-256
an independently hashed IMMUTABLE_REVISION_ACCESSIBLE repository audit
exact coverage of every required and conservative dependent in the ownership ledger
for every dependent: terminal-accepted lifecycle, three-seed summary, and accepted-evidence archive with valid inventories
live_fail_closed_checks: target and quarantine are literal exact children of an eligible AgentEnhance cache/models root
target, quarantine, and all model contents are not symlinks or mount points
materialization repository, revision, target, file count, and bytes equal the ownership ledger
MODEL_SHA256SUMS covers exactly every current model file and every hash matches
live tree identity equals the dry-run record
lsof reports no process reference to the exact current model root
all dependent lifecycle, summary, archive, denominator, method identity, and inventory checks pass again

phase_semantics.preflight: Read-only; prints DRY_RUN_ELIGIBLE only after all frozen and live checks pass.
phase_semantics.quarantine: Atomically rename only the exact model root to its predeclared unique sibling on the same filesystem, rehash it, repeat the process audit, and write an immutable QUARANTINED record.
phase_semantics.delete: Revalidate the eligibility record, quarantined tree, all dependent evidence, and no-process state; delete only the literal quarantine root; verify original and quarantine absence and retained-evidence presence; write an immutable DELETED record.

protected_assets: all pre-existing/shared models and every dataset, source, environment, run, result, log, manifest, and archive
authorization: This controller is implementation-only and authorizes no current deletion. Each future model requires its own fully rendered, independently reviewed DRY_RUN_ELIGIBLE record after all dependents are retired and archived.
failure_rule: Any missing, ambiguous, inaccessible, active, mismatched, partial, symlinked, mounted, unarchived, or unexpected state stops before mutation. A failure after quarantine preserves the quarantine for a fresh audit; no in-place evidence repair is allowed.
